app.title: Talorys – A self-hosted personal AI agent on Cloudflare's free tier
app.author: rociiu
app.description: Talorys is a self‑hosted personal AI agent built on Cloudflare Workers and Rust. It supports custom prompts, knowledge bases, and can be interacted with via HTTP API or a simple web UI.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run `cargo build` to ensure Rust toolchain works
Execute the default demo script and verify it returns a coherent response to a simple prompt
Send a custom prompt via the HTTP API and assert the response contains expected keywords
Measure latency of the API call and compare against a baseline (e.g., Ollama)
Deploy the agent on Cloudflare Workers and test that the deployment URL responds correctly
